translation: The gadi (seat of succession) was taken from Hansapura to Bodeli. There, that gadi continues to this day, but no member of the swami's family now sits upon it as swami; it is run by trustees. The tulsi-kyaros (tulsi-plant memorial platforms marking a departed saint's resting place) of the swamis who occupied the gadi are at Bodeli, but no tulsi-kyaro has been built for the last swami, Bapalal. Thus this Bodeli is a sacred site.
